validation.description: Enable DNSSEC validation in the upstream resolver (Unbound/BIND). Required for correct DNSSEC behavior.

unbound_conf.description: Path to the Unbound configuration file that dnssec-trigger will modify to enable DNSSEC.

bind_conf.description: Path to the BIND configuration file (e.g., /etc/named.conf). Leave empty if only using Unbound.

items.description: Path to a file containing a root key tag (KSK) for DNSSEC trust anchor validation.

trust_anchor_files.description: List of files containing trusted root DNSKEY key tags. Used for initial trust anchor setup and fallback.

auto_update.description: Allow dnssec-trigger to automatically update the DNSSEC trust anchor (RFC 5011) based on DNSKEY RRs from the root zone.

description.description: Human-readable description of the hook’s purpose (e.g., 'Notify monitoring system')

path.description: Absolute path to the executable script or binary to run.

hooks.description: Scripts to run on trust anchor change, validation failure, or other events. Each hook is called with event type and payload on stdout.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for troubleshooting and debugging.

refresh_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between checks for new trust anchors (e.g., root DNSKEY updates). Default is 24 hours.

name.description: Logical name for the module (used in logs and messages).

path.description: Path to the shared library (.so) or Python script implementing the module.

modules.description: Optional custom modules to extend dnssec-trigger behavior (e.g., support for non-standard DNSSEC key sources).
